svg.text: Flood Early Warning System: Hardware Overview
Sensor node runs firmware V9.1 (deployed). The receiver node plays the same stage audio at the tower from the SMS; people also get the SMS as a backup.
Sensor node: solar-charged 12 V 7.5 Ah battery. Siren tower: 220 V AC mains.
IP5306 power path (5 V in), setupPMU()
Accepts SMS only from the sensor node's number and plays the same
pre-recorded audio for each stage. Receiver firmware v2.

g.text: • Each float: 200 ms noise filter, then the level must hold 5 s.
• Min 60 s between status changes (stops flip-flopping).
• A remote press overrides the floats for 10 s.
• Relay powers the amplifier only while the DFPlayer is playing.
• Daily self-test: plays a song + sends "system normal" SMS twice a day.
